description: This file defines an abstract base class 'TestClusterPerTest' used for setting up, managing, and tearing down Orleans test clusters within an Xunit testing environment. It includes configuration, initialization, and disposal logic for test clusters and related resources.

classes.name: TestClusterPerTest
classes.description: An abstract class providing setup and teardown logic for Orleans test clusters in unit tests, with configuration hooks and exception handling.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes and deploys the test cluster, applying configuration settings.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the test cluster and stops all silos.

methods.name: EnsurePreconditionsMet
methods.description: Checks if the preconditions exception was set and throws it if so.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Virtual method to check preconditions before test execution.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Virtual method for subclasses to customize test cluster configuration.
